title: Rebuild TrackLearningOrderScreen's masechtos ReorderableListView with a lazy builder, not shrinkWrap+children

evidence.quote:
static bool hasReorderableLevel2(CurriculumId id) =>
      id != CurriculumId.chumash && id != CurriculumId.tanach;

why: Track Detail's 'Reorder Learning Order' tile (track_detail_screen.dart:642-658, one tap: `onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).push(MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => TrackLearningOrderScreen(...)))`) opens a screen whose masechtos section renders one DraggableOrderItem (a ListTile wrapped in ReorderableDragStartListener, itself a ConsumerWidget with its own label-provider watch) per distinct level-2 hierarchy value of the track's curriculum, via the plain (non-.builder) ReorderableListView constructor with shrinkWrap:true nested inside a SingleChildScrollView. hasReorderableLevel2 enables this section for every curriculum except Chumash/Tanach. I counted distinct level-2 values directly from the bundled assets/content/hierarchy/*.json: Mishna Berurah=697 (Simanim), Mishneh Torah=85, Mussar=59, Mishnayos=63, Yerushalmi=39, Bavli=37. Any user with one of these active tracks — the majority of the app's curricula — who taps 'Reorder Learning Order' forces the screen to synchronously build and lay out every one of those rows in one frame: shrinkWrap:true requires the sliver to size itself before the outer SingleChildScrollView can lay out, so simply swapping to `.builder` without also removing shrinkWrap would not fix it. This is the most severe PF-2 site found in this pass: worst-case count (697) is the highest found, per-item cost is heavier than a bare ListTile, and it is reached by an ordinary, one-tap, documented user action on ordinary curricula (not an edge case).
recommendation: Replace `ReorderableListView(children:...)` with `ReorderableListView.builder(itemCount: _localMasechtos!.length, itemBuilder: ...)`, and remove the shrinkWrap:true + SingleChildScrollView nesting — host the sedarim and masechtos sections in a single CustomScrollView with SliverReorderableList sections (or SliverList for read-only rows) instead, so the shrinkWrap-forced full eager layout is eliminated along with the eager builder.
acceptance_criteria: Rule-0: PF-2 checker (grep/custom_lint) flags `ReorderableListView(` (non-.builder) combined with `shrinkWrap: true` anywhere under lib/features/**.

Regression test: pump TrackLearningOrderScreen for a Mishna Berurah track backed by a 700-item trackMasechtosOrderProvider fixture; assert via find.byType(DraggableOrderItem) that only a viewport's worth of rows are realized (not all 700), and that tester.pumpAndSettle completes within a bounded frame budget instead of timing out.
